name: Pixel Peaks
description: A tiny pixel-art platformer: run, jump, stomp slimes and collect coins across three levels.
controls: Arrows/WASD move, Space/Up/Z jump (hold for higher), Down+Jump drops through platforms, M mute. Touch: on-screen buttons.

achievements.name: Coin Collector
achievements.description: Collect 25 coins in a single run.

achievements.name: Summit
achievements.description: Reach the final flag of all three levels.
